application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details of condition 7 (Hard and Soft Landscape) submitted pursuant of planning permission 00793/L/P3 dated 07/01/2022 for Clearance of all existing structures on site and construction of two residential blocks (11 and 14 storeys in height) to provide 176 residential units, associated car and cycle parking, access layout and hard and soft landscaping.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The submitted information fails to provide sufficient details regarding the landscape management plan, planting details, green roof details, lighting details, material schedule, specifications for furniture and boundary treatments, details of quiet zone communal amenity areas, signage details, and CCTV details as well as failing to demonstrate that the proposal would be fully accessible for wheelchair users and not achieving a 2m wide footway and would therefore fail to satisfy the requirements of the condition, contrary to Local Plan (2015) policies CC1, CC2 and GB7 and London Plan (2015) policy S4.
